user.title: Accu Planner
user.description: Plans charging and discharging of your home battery based on quarter-hour prices. Battery control, grid meter and execution can be set afterwards under Configure.

control.title: Battery charge settings
control.description: With the 'Execute battery plan' switch on, the battery charges by the schedule and on solar surplus. It is controlled with the entities from Grid & Battery settings: {mode_entity} and {power_entity}.

plan.name: Charge by plan
plan.description: Charge windows of the planner always take precedence.

data.control_charge_at_max: Always charge at max charge power
data.control_safe_on_off: Return to discharge setting when switched off

data_description.plan_charge_enabled: Off: the planner's charge windows are not executed (solar surplus charging and discharging still work)
data_description.control_charge_at_max: Off: the planned charge power of the quarter
data_description.control_power_discharge: After a charge window the battery returns once to the discharge option with this power
data_description.control_safe_on_off: Also used when the plan is outdated or failed

solar.name: Charge on solar surplus
solar.description: Outside charge windows the charge power follows the grid export (measure every 3 s, adjust every 15 s: +0.6 × surplus, max +400 / −1000 W per step). 0 W = hold the battery. Uses the grid meter from Grid & Battery settings: {export_entity} / {import_entity}.

data.solar_below_discharge_price: Only when the price is below the discharge price

data_description.solar_pv_entity: The regulator only measures while this sensor produces > 1 W, e.g. sensor.growatt_solar_ac_power. Empty = always measure
data_description.solar_min_power: Below this target 0 W is sent
data_description.solar_below_discharge_price: Above the discharge price the battery is left to Battery discharge settings

discharge.title: Battery discharge settings
discharge.description:
Uses the battery control from Grid & Battery settings:
• mode entity {mode_entity} → option '{discharge_option}'
• power entity {power_entity}
and the grid meter: {export_entity} (export) / {import_entity} (import).

Above the discharge price the battery supplies exactly the house consumption (grid import towards 0 W: measured every 3 s, adjusted at the chosen reaction speed). Above the sell price it discharges at full power and exports. At or below the discharge price, or while the car is charging, the power goes to 0 W. Only active while 'Execute battery plan' is on.

data.discharge_car_block: Do not discharge while the car is charging

data_description.discharge_min_power: Below this target 0 W is sent
data_description.discharge_hysteresis: Once discharging, keep discharging until the price drops this much below the discharge price (prevents switching on and off as the discharge price moves with the SOC)
data_description.discharge_sell_enabled: On: above the sell price the battery discharges at full power (Power when selling) and exports to the grid; the charge plan also plans selling. Off: the battery never exports, it only discharges to your own consumption, and the planner does not plan selling. Sell price = (stored energy cost + wear cost & discharge margin) × (1 + profit percentage), see the Sell price sensor
data_description.discharge_speed: How fast the discharge power follows changes in consumption. Slow: short peaks (kettle, oven switching) are ignored, only sustained changes are followed (1 = adjust every 60 s). Fast: also follows shorter peaks (10 = every 5 s). Default 4 = adjust every 20 s by 0.25 × the import
data_description.discharge_car_block: Above 0 W on the car charger sensor the battery does not discharge (0 W), so the car is not charged from the battery
data_description.discharge_car_entity: Power of the car charger (W or kW), e.g. sensor.charger_power_active_import

grid.title: Grid & Battery settings
grid.description: The battery entities and the grid meter (e.g. P1). Used by Battery charge settings and Battery discharge settings; the mode is set first, then the power.

data_description.capacity_sensor: Total capacity in kWh or Wh, e.g. sensor.buiten_anker_solix_battery_capacity
data_description.soc_sensor: State of charge in %, e.g. sensor.buiten_anker_solix_soc
data_description.control_option_charge: Option of the mode entity for charging, e.g. charge
data_description.control_option_discharge: Option of the mode entity for discharging (also used after charging), e.g. discharge
data_description.solar_export_entity: Power fed into the grid, W or kW, e.g. sensor.power_production
data_description.solar_import_entity: Power drawn from the grid, W or kW, e.g. sensor.power_consumption
